# Lumina (Lumina Labs, Inc.) — formerly InboxZap

> Lumina joins video calls, records and transcribes them, and turns each meeting into a structured summary with decisions and action items. Pivoted in 2026 from InboxZap, an email-inbox-cleanup tool (bulk delete, unsubscribe, inbox zero) — the two products share no feature overlap. GSC still carries meaningful historical impressions for InboxZap-era queries; see `.seoagent/strategy/migration-plan.md` for the harvest/redirect/sunset disposition of that legacy equity.

## Pages

- [Lumina — The AI Meeting Assistant for Teams](https://lumina.example/): Lumina records, transcribes, and summarizes your team's meetings, then turns them into action items automatically. Free for teams up to 5.
- [Blog — Lumina](https://lumina.example/blog): The Lumina blog: articles on meetings, productivity, and teamwork.
- [Features — Lumina AI Meeting Assistant](https://lumina.example/features): Everything Lumina does in your meetings: recording, speaker-labeled transcription, AI summaries, action items, and integrations with Slack and Notion.
- [Pricing — Lumina AI Meeting Assistant](https://lumina.example/pricing): Lumina pricing: free for teams up to 5, Pro at $12 per seat per month, and custom Enterprise plans. Every plan includes unlimited transcription.
